[EN] (The obelisk emits an eerie sensation. Your heart feels heavy and your limbs feel like they're being pulled from you as you approach the obelisk.)
[ES] (El obelisco emite una sensación inquietante. Tu corazón se siente pesado y tus extremidades parecen estar siendo arrancadas de ti a medida que te acercas al obelisco.)
